designBrief: Quiet park-side cafe inside Clementi Woods Park, Singapore. Palette pulled from the business's own real logo (deep emerald/teal, warm gold) plus a moss-green nod to the literal park setting, on a warm cream background. Fraunces (dialed toward its rounded SOFT axis, WONK off) for headings, Karla for body — matching a real voice sample that is plain and unhyped. Single-page, photography-led, generous whitespace, minimal nav. Signature element: an abstracted 4-petal pinwheel mark, referencing the real decorative ornaments visible outside the storefront, used sparingly as a section-divider/menu-marker/footer motif rather than literal decoration.
